title: The Bracelet String Long Enough
youtube_title: The Bracelet String Long Enough | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Wynn is just outside the fun, close to a bracelet string measured for two wrists. Yael changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Wynn has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
